detail: Full summary: Confirmed empirically (old-code migrate then new-code rerun on the same store): a store migrated PRE-fix after identity init is NOT healed — legacy/migration-state.json identity wins and the identity-init ids are absent from store.json entirely (not even in repo_ids). Detector for the trial arm: distinct scope.repo values across events/ vs store.json repo_id; a state identity store_id without the ULID timestamp prefix (s_01M…) is path-seeded.
